source.title: CodeCompass 7.2.0: Structural code context for AI coding agents
source.summary: A local code knowledge graph and MCP server for impact analysis, dependency tracing, flow analysis and targeted repository navigation; the project page reports release 7.2.0 and documents a graph-first alternative to repeated grep/read exploration.
